top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, independently confirmed discovery arc: Holst on human GLP-1 incretin physiology, Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and the therapeutic concept. Randomized outcome trials in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal endpoints confirm the consequence. Each laureate maps onto a distinct step and the set fits three seats. The citation is anchored on physiology and the active peptide, so it rewards discovery, not a product. Attribution relative to the Habener group remains the main weakness, but it does not outweigh awarding nothing.
